restaurant_name: Tooth Time Dental Clinic (คลินิกทันตกรรมทูธไทม์)
text:
This review is long overdue. I’ve followed Dr. Pawat around Chiang Mai for years because he’s that good—and since 2022 I’ve been visiting him at his own clinic, Tooth Time Dental Clinic.

What I appreciate most is his integrity and precision. He explains options clearly, never pushes unnecessary work, and advises like you’re family. His bonding/fillings are next-level—smooth, natural, and durable—and he’s excellent with cosmetic dentistry. I’m planning veneers with him next.

Both my partner and her mother have trusted him with everything from routine cleanings to more complex cases, and the results have always been on point. He uses proven materials and techniques, and you can feel the pride he takes in his craft.

Even after moving out of Chiang Mai, we schedule our dental work around visits back because we trust him that much. We were in again today for a cleaning and a filling—same great experience, start to finish.

If you want meticulous work, honest guidance, and a calm, professional chairside manner, go see Dr. Pawat at Tooth Time. Truly a master of his field. 🙏
